description: Put an image into the user's Uploads library ("Your Uploads" in every picker) and get back a ref for compose_design's images.* fields. Needs an API key with design:write. Send the file as base64 (JPEG/PNG/WebP preferred, at the panel size describe_format reports; keep it under 3 MB — bigger files go through POST https://vhs.texs.org/api/v1/uploads as multipart). Identical bytes already in the library return the existing item instead of a copy.

data.description: Base64 of the image bytes (no data: prefix needed; one is tolerated)

name.description: A filename or label shown in the library, e.g. "predator-front.png"

name: upload_image
